integrity: All algebraic arguments and finite computations are described and reproducible; prior background is acknowledged; scientific review is self-review only, with no independent proof or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Two complete frequency-line slices on the specific unit conic; odd prime-power fields; arbitrary complex coefficients; injectivity and nullspaces, not noisy stability or phase retrieval. The proof is unrestricted but direct computations cover only ten small fields. Historical-priority risk from other finite-field conic tomography work remains.
title: Exact arithmetic nullities in two-view Fourier tomography of finite-field conics
